messages:
Ana Gomez: Heads-up: our renewal models are being skewed by long-dormant trials that never converted. Proposing a safe, reversible playbook: tag trials with last_active > 120d as `cs:stale_trial` and exclude tags from operational dashboards and training datasets. Do we want to archive immediately or tag-first?

Ravi Singh: Tag-first please. If we archive right away we'll lose provenance and complicate support lookups. How many accounts would that touch?

Ana Gomez: Quick slice returned ~940 accounts across NA/EU. Query I ran:

```sql
SELECT id AS account_id, account_type, last_active_at, health_score, owner_id
FROM accounts
WHERE account_type = 'trial' AND last_active_at < now() - interval '120 days' AND status != 'archived';
```

Dara Kim: Agree with tagging. Suggest two-step playbook: 1) apply `cs:stale_trial:YYYY-MM` tag and emit audit event; 2) after 30 days, auto-archive only if no activity and not on BI safe-list.

Ben Torres: +1. Also add a rule to preserve historical health_score in an audit column (health_score_history) and set active health_score to null for dashboards to avoid accidental aggregation.

Ravi Singh: For the playbook webhook, here's a minimal example to run in staging:

```yaml
trigger: cron: daily
filter:
  - account_type: trial
  - last_active_days: ">=120"
actions:
  - tag: cs:stale_trial:2026-03
  - emit_event: cs.trial_stale_tagged
  - notify: channel: #customer-success-admins, text: "Tagged {account_id} as stale_trial"
```

Ana Gomez: Important: exclude any account with open opportunities > 0 or enablement tasks created within 180d. I'll update the filter accordingly.

Dara Kim: We'll need a regression check: health_score cohort delta (rolling 14d) < 1.5% after tagging phase. If exceeded, auto-revert tags and pause rollout. I'll add an alert to the healthscore monitor.

Ben Torres: BI safe-list: opp_value >= 5000 OR owner_notes contains "ps-engagement". I'll push the safe-list query to the shared BI dashboard and link it here.

cs-bot: playbook-runner: scheduled cron job `stale-trial-tagger` -> staging dry-run at 2026-03-23T06:00:00Z (run id: pt-3345)

Ravi Singh: Rollout plan (short):
- Phase 0: dry-run logs only (staging) -> verify counts (today)
- Phase 1: tag-only in staging -> run for 3 days (owner verification)
- Phase 2: tag-only in prod (pilot 2% sample) -> monitor 7 days
- Phase 3: tag-only 100% -> monitor 14 days
- Phase 4: archive eligible (5% pilot) -> escalate if drift > 1.5%
I'll take ownership of phased rollout.

Ana Gomez: Action items:
- Ravi: run phased rollout and post checkpoints (ETA Fri)
- Dara: add healthscore regression alert and rollback automation (ETA Wed)
- Ben: publish BI safe-list and share query (ETA Thu)
- Ana: PR for playbook webhook + staging dry-run (ETA Thu)

Dara Kim: Also recommend adding a quick customer-success note template for owners so they can reach out before archive if they want to rescue an account. I'll draft it.

Ben Torres: Copying the draft query into BI now, will ping when live. :thumbsup:

Ana Gomez: Thanks everyone. We'll keep the tag-first approach to minimize reporting churn. I'll post the staging dry-run link once cs-bot finishes pt-3345.

cs-bot: reminder: add run notes for pt-3345 after job completes.
